digest.component_or_area: inbound fetcher / projects store / apply inbound records
propositions: The inbound fetcher currently processes only a single project, discarding parent/comment/issuelink enrichment data for all but one project in a multi-project store mapping
Inbound-created tickets do not record their source project in bridge_project or repos fields, leaving provenance information unset
The fetcher must fan out JQL queries and all three enrichment passes once per project in the store mapping, merging results into a shared snapshot with per-project truncation ceilings
For unseeded (empty) mappings, the fetcher must fall back to single-project behavior to ensure backward compatibility and byte-for-byte identical query pairs
Source project and default repos must be derived from the inbound ticket's jira key prefix and stamped via a new projects_store helper at the CREATE write site
